## Walkthrough

Introduces a configurable `maxHeapPointer` to constrain heap growth, lowers the eager page allocation threshold from 512MB to 2MB, adds sbrk-focused tests exercising heap limits and faults, and expands SPI memory-layout documentation.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Memory allocation thresholds** <br> `assembly/memory-page.ts` | Reduced `ALLOCATE_EAGERLY` from `2 ** 29` to `2 ** 21`, shifting the eager vs. lazy page allocation cutoff. |
| **Memory growth constraints** <br> `assembly/memory.ts` | Added `MAX_MEMORY_ADDRESS`; `MemoryBuilder.build()` now accepts `maxHeapPointer` (default `MAX_MEMORY_ADDRESS`) and `Memory` stores `maxHeapPointer`. `Memory.sbrk()` enforces growth against `this.maxHeapPointer` instead of `MEMORY_SIZE`. |
| **Memory tests** <br> `assembly/memory.test.ts` | Added `MAX_MEMORY_INDEX` and ~85 lines of sbrk tests covering zero allocation, returned previous address on alloc, faults when exceeding limits, allocation up to custom maxHeapPointer, and stack/heap boundary checks. |
| **SPI documentation / memory bounds** <br> `assembly/spi.ts` | Removed `heapZerosEnd` computation; memory constructed using `heapZerosStart + heapZerosLength` as boundary and added detailed SPI memory-layout comments. |
| **Build configuration** <br> `biome.jsonc`, `package.json` | Bumped Biome schema / devDependency from `2.3.8` to `2.3.11`. |
